name: AXM Game Forge
summary: One game-development workspace with instant map preview, reviewed package building, modular runtimes, multiplayer lobby and play-test flow.
notes: Game Forge v1.1 makes semantic maps immediately playable and builds verified package candidates under exports without installing them. Existing Game Hub runtimes, four-seat lobby, QR controllers, package verifier and Studio asset handoff remain the execution path. A 3D preview interprets terrain and height but does not claim a general-purpose 3D engine.
